channel.title: CrowAgent Changelog
channel.description: Public release notes from CrowAgent: product, free tools, regulatory and marketing-surface updates.

item.title: MP1: Marketing surface (tools hub, methodology pages, cookie preferences, changelog)
item.description: New /tools hub aggregating six free regulator-grade tools, six SEO landing pages, six long-form methodology pages, /cookie-preferences with three-category consent model, /changelog with RSS endpoint, and top nav and footer extended with a Free Tools surface.

item.title: Cloudflare Pages migration complete
item.description: crowagent.ai now serves from Cloudflare Pages (project crowagent-website). app.crowagent.ai and portal.crowagent.ai remain on Vercel. Eliminated cross-repo Vercel deployment risk.

item.title: PPN 002 published
item.description: PPN 002 published 13 February 2025 and mandatory for procurements commenced under the Procurement Act 2023 on or after 1 October 2025; minimum social value weighting set at 10%. CrowMark mission mapping updated to PPN 002. PPN 06/20 retained for procurements that commenced under the earlier framework.
